rationale: image-size's ICNS parser can loop indefinitely on a crafted buffer (CVE-2025-71330). The GitHub advisory lists no patched version ("Patched versions: None"); the upstream fix (image-size/image-size#439) was unreleased as of 2026-08-22. image-size@1.2.1 is a transitive dependency of metro@0.81.5 (React Native bundler) and is present only in the mobile toolchain. It is not in the API or web production dependency tree.
compensatingControl: The vulnerable parser is only reachable through Metro's explicit image-dimension probing of developer-local source assets during mobile development and builds. The API and web production runtimes never load or execute image-size, and no product code parses untrusted image buffers with it. A remote attacker has no input path to this code in any deployed service.
